title: Free rooms and broken rooms:
items: Write the complimentary stay on the bill, so the room still shows in your books.
One line on the bill: guest, reason, who said yes.
Block a room the moment it breaks.
Repair, leak, AC down: block it on the room board before the next booking.
Someone looks at the room first, then it goes back on sale.
Count unsold and free nights weekly.
A room that earns nothing still costs power, staff and laundry.
footer: Complimentary stays on the bill and blocked rooms on the live room board in Sutrixa Rizstay.
